# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use GitHub’s **Report a vulnerability** option on the repository’s Security tab.
Private vulnerability reporting is enabled so reports, follow-up questions, and any
coordinated fix can remain confidential until disclosure is appropriate.

Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability or include credentials,
tokens, private exploit details, or personal data in public repository content.

For supply-chain controls applied to this repository, see
[`SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md`](../SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md).

## Supported Content

This repository publishes documentation and small validation utilities rather than a
versioned runtime product.
Security fixes are applied to the default branch; older Git revisions are not maintained
as supported release lines.
